column1: # An all-refused image profile ledger, for a preset generation that arms the web
# lane alone. remote/image-profiles.tsv carries one validator-gated row, so a
# generator run that names no image ledger requires the five image MCP inputs of
# a lane the caller never meant to arm; naming this file withholds the lane and
# leaves every other rule the generator applies unchanged. The row names the
# checked-in bundle, because remote/image-registry.sh validates the profile
